raw.details:
Think. Build. Deploy. Present.

Have an idea that can solve a real-world problem? Don't just present it — build it.

SPIRIT 3.0 – Buildathon is an 8-hour offline buildathon organized by Team SPIRIT, Dr. Shakuntala Misra National Rehabilitation University (DSMNRU), Lucknow, bringing together students, developers, designers, innovators, and problem-solvers from across India.

The competition starts with an online idea-screening round, followed by an 8-hour offline buildathon for shortlisted teams.

Themes:

Assistive Technology

  • Build solutions focused on accessibility, communication, mobility, education, rehabilitation, independence, or improving quality of life.

FinTech & Security

  • Build solutions around financial technology, digital payments, financial inclusion, fraud detection, cybersecurity, privacy, digital identity, or secure transactions.

Open Innovation

  • No predefined problem. Identify a meaningful real-world problem and build an innovative technology-driven solution.

Who Can Participate?

  • Students from Any Recognized College/university in India
  • Team Size: 2–4 Members
  • Inter-College and Inter-University Teams Allowed
  • Inter-Branch/specialization Teams Allowed
  • One Participant Can Belong to Only One Team
  • Every Team Must Have One Team Leader

One Person = One Role

Organizer and Participant Roles Cannot Overlap:

  • Anyone Selected as An Spirit 3.0 Organizer Cannot Participate as A Contestant/team Member, and Vice Versa. This Applies to Students from Dsmnru and Other Institutions.
  • Violation May Result in Cancellation of Registration And/or Team Disqualification.

Competition Format

  • Round 1 — Idea Screening
  • Registration Deadline: 16 October 2026
    Ppt/pdf Submission: 17–19 October 2026
  • Submit an 8–10 Slide Ppt/pdf explaining Your Idea.

Your Presentation Should Clearly Cover:

  • Problem
  • Proposed Solution
  • Target Users
  • Key Features
  • Technology/tech Stack
  • Innovation
  • Impact
  • Implementation Approach
  • Team Details

Maximum 10 Slides. presentations Exceeding 10 Slides Will Not Be Considered.

Shortlisted Teams Will Receive Confirmation via Email.

Round 2 — Offline Buildathon

Date: 24 October 2026
Venue: dsmnru Campus, Lucknow
Mode: offline
Duration: 8 Hours

Shortlisted Teams Will Build, Test, Deploy Where Applicable, and Demonstrate Their Solution.

Your Project Must Work:

The Final Submission Must Include a Functional Working Prototype.

Examples:

  • Web/mobile Application
  • Ai/ml Application
  • Live Api/backend
  • Assistive Technology Prototype
  • Functional Software or Other Technology-Based Solutions

A Ppt, Concept, Screenshot, or Static Ui Alone Is Not a Complete Final Submission.

Teams Must Present Their Working Project Through a Live Demo + Final Presentation + Q&a.

Evaluation

Projects May Be Evaluated On:

  • Problem Understanding
  • Innovation & Originality
  • Technical Implementation
  • Functionality
  • Theme Relevance
  • Impact & Scalability
  • Design & Usability
  • Presentation & Overall Execution

One Overall Winning Team will Be Selected Across All Three Themes.
No Runner-Up Category.

Registration Fee : INR 100 per Team

  • The Fee Is for The Entire Team, Not per Member.
  • Example: 4-Member Team = ₹100 Total
  • Payment Will Be Made by The Team Leader.
  • The Registration Fee Is Strictly Non-Refundable, Including in Cases of Non-Selection, Withdrawal, Absence, Non-Submission, Disqualification, or Inability to Participate.

Ai, Ap Is & Open-Source

Teams May Use:

  • Ai Tools
  • Ap Is
  • Open-Source Libraries/frameworks
  • Datasets
  • Development Platforms
  • Third-Party Services

However, Teams Must Understand and Explain Their Solution, Architecture, Implementation, and Use of External Resources.

Plagiarism, Copied Projects, or Unauthorized Use of Another Team's Work Is Not Allowed.

Important Dates:

Activity Date
Registration Deadline 16 October 2026
Ppt/pdf Submission 17–19 October 2026
Shortlist Announcement Via Email
Offline Buildathon 24 October 2026
Build Duration 8 Hours

Event at A Glance

  • Location: dsmnru, Lucknow
  • Mode: online Screening + Offline Final
  • Team Size: 2–4
  • Fee: ₹100 per Team
  • Themes: assistive Technology | Fin Tech & Security | Open Innovation
  • Round 1: 8–10 Slide Idea Ppt/pdf
  • Round 2: 8-Hour Offline Buildathon
  • Final: working Prototype + Presentation + Demo + Q&a
  • Winner: one Overall Winning Team per Theme 

Think. Build. Deploy. Present.

SPIRIT 3.0 – Buildathon 2026
